question: The International Solar Alliance is a collaborative initiative between India and ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**France**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **The International Solar Alliance (ISA)** is a joint initiative launched by **India and France** during the 21st session of the Conference of the Parties (COP-21) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) in Paris on **30th November 2015**. 
• The primary aim of the ISA is to promote the use of **solar energy**, facilitate energy access, and help in reducing dependence on fossil fuels to combat climate change. 
• It is a coalition of **solar resource-rich countries** that lie fully or partially between the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn, although other countries can also join the alliance. 
• ISA focuses on key areas such as **scaling solar applications** for agricultural use, scaling solar mini-grids, and scaling rooftop solar installations. 
• The headquarters of the ISA is located in **Gurugram, India**, and it is the first international intergovernmental organization to have its headquarters in India. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
• **Objectives of the International Solar Alliance:** 
• To reduce the cost of solar energy and its components through bulk purchase and local manufacturing. 
• To mobilize financial resources for the development of solar energy projects in member countries. 
• To promote research and development in solar energy and its applications. 
• To increase the use of solar technologies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and promote sustainable development. 
• **Key Initiatives under ISA:** 
• **One Sun, One World, One Grid:** This initiative aims to interconnect solar energy grids across countries to ensure a reliable supply of clean energy globally. 
• **STAR-C program:** Aims to develop solar technology application and research centers across member countries. 
• **Affordable Finance at Scale:** Seeks to lower the cost of capital for solar projects by leveraging international public finance. 
• **France’s Role in ISA:** 
• France has been a key partner of India in this initiative, providing technical and financial support to operationalize the ISA framework. 
• The French Development Agency (AFD) has committed significant financial resources to support solar energy projects under the ISA initiative. 
• **Partnerships and Membership:** 
• As of 2023, **124 countries** have signed the ISA framework agreement, out of which more than 90 have ratified it. 
• Major partners include the European Union, the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), and the World Bank. 
• **Milestones Achieved:** 
• The ISA has launched several global programs, such as the **Affordable Solar Power for Agriculture** and **Scaling Solar Applications for Agricultural Use (SSAAU)**. 
• It has been instrumental in mobilizing investments in **solar energy infrastructure** across developing countries.
